comments: This work is not extant. It is listed by A khu shes rab rgya mtsho in the Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 674, No. 11812: 'jam gsar gyi rnam nges Tik+ka). This might be the same work as the  tshad ma rnam nges kyi rgyan mentionned in <<bKa' gdams gsung 'bum dkar chag [S635TW6P]>>: 78.
name: rnam nges Tik+ka (2)
